propertySets.name: Pset_DamperTypeFireDamper
propertySets.definition:
Fire damper type attributes.
Pset renamed from Pset_DamperTypeFire to Pset_DamperTypeFireDamper in IFC2x2 Pset Addendum.

properties.name: ActuationType
properties.definition: Enumeration that identifies the different types of dampers.

properties.name: ClosureRatingEnum
properties.definition: Enumeration that identifies the closure rating for the damper.

properties.name: FireResistanceRating
properties.definition: Measure of the fire resistance rating in hours (e.g., 1.5 hours, 2 hours, etc.).

properties.name: FusibleLinkTemperature
properties.definition: The temperature that the fusible link melts.
